newsitem.title: INDIA: India Pond's '96 final div 12.5 rupees.
newsitem.headline: India Pond's '96 final div 12.5 rupees.

text.p: Pond's (India) Ltd will pay a final dividend of 12.5 rupees per 10-rupee face value share for calendar 1996 against nine rupees for 1995, the company said on Saturday.

The company had already paid an interim dividend of 7.5 rupees per share for 1996 against 6.0 rupees in 1995, the firm said in a statement to the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) after a board meeting in Madras.
The total dividend for 1996 totals 20 rupees a share against 15 rupees in 1995.
The company's board also reconfirmed the unaudited results announced in January after audit.
Net profit for calendar 1996 rose to 469.5 million rupees from 378.0 million in 1995 on higher net sales of 3.95 billion rupees against 3.17 billion.
Shareholders whose names are in the register on June 20, 1997, when it holds its annual general meeting of shareholders, will be eligible for the final dividend, the firm said.
For this purpose the register and share transfer books are closed from May 20, 1997 to June 20, it said.
Cosmetics maker Pond's is a subsidiary of Anglo-Dutch conglomerate Unilever Plc and part of the Hindustan Lever group.
